text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes all 16 tests. I didn't touch the tests. I fixed these bugs in `catalog/`:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the comment and tests say five. It is now 5.
- **`fees.py`:** the fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing "Emma". I added it as `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my choice, matching the Austen books in `test_search.py`. The tests only check the title.
